UserStudyProgress.title: UserStudyProgress
UserStudyProgress.description: Tracks per-user daily study streak, last activity date, mastered term IDs, bookmarked term IDs, and quiz high score.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this progress record.

displayName.description: Display name of the authenticated learner.

streakCount.description: Current consecutive days the user has studied or interacted with the app.

longestStreak.description: Highest consecutive daily study streak achieved by this user.

lastActiveDate.description: Local calendar date of the user's last study interaction in YYYY-MM-DD format.

quizHighScore.description: Highest percentage score (0-100) achieved on the interview quiz.

quizAttempts.description: Total number of completed quiz attempts.

masteredIds.description: Bounded list of mastered term IDs (maximum 100 items).

bookmarkedIds.description: Bounded list of bookmarked term IDs (maximum 100 items).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user study profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user study profile was last updated.

/userStudyProgress/{userId}.description: Stores isolated per-user study streak, last activity date, and mastery state keyed by the user's Firebase Auth UID.
